# Okorder.com

> > A leading B2B marketplace connecting global buyers with Chinese manufacturers and suppliers of industrial materials, construction products, and equipment.

Okorder.com is a comprehensive supplier marketplace specializing in bulk industrial materials and building products sourced from China and distributed internationally. The platform serves manufacturers, contractors, and businesses seeking reliable sourcing of everything from waterproofing membranes and insulation materials to aluminum foils and composite manufacturing supplies.
